verdict.rationale: Featurebase exposes a Posts API and webhooks that fire on status changes (e.g., when a post is marked approved/planned), which a developer could use to pull an approved spec into an external delivery tool, and there's a generic mention of integrations. However there is no explicit documentation of a native Jira/Linear/GitHub sync or an 'export to delivery workflow' feature. Missing for 10: named integrations with issue trackers (Jira, Linear, GitHub), a documented spec/export field for approved posts, and any first-party guide showing an end-to-end handoff from feedback approval to implementation ticket creation.
